name: wolfbud
description: WolfBud: a voice coworker (ElevenLabs agent + 3D wolf) that watches the session and can send prompts to Claude

api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key
api_key.description: The local bridge mints call tokens with it. Falls back to the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable.

port.title: Bridge port
port.description: Preferred local port for the WolfBud window; the next nine are tried when it's taken.

browser.title: Window
browser.description: auto: a tab in Orca's built-in browser when this session runs in Orca, else chrome-app. chrome-app: a dedicated Chrome app window (keeps the mic grant, lets the pane start calls). orca-browser: a tab in Orca's built-in browser (needs this session to run in Orca; falls back to chrome-app). terminal-browser: a split pane in your terminal (needs the terminal-browser CLI; falls back to chrome-app). default: your default browser.
